without fetching every page individually.

## Company Quick Facts

- **Full name**: Shandong Haonuo Machinery Equipment Group Co., Ltd.
- **Brand**: Haonuo Machinery
- **Founded**: 2010
- **Location**: Qingzhou, Weifang, Shandong Province, China
- **Factory**: 8,000 m2 workshop, 200+ workers, own CNC machining center
- **Exported to**: 40+ countries (Nigeria, Kenya, India, Indonesia, Egypt, Pakistan, South Africa, Philippines, UAE, UK, USA)
- **Production capacity**: 300-620 ton hydraulic presses + seed processing equipment
- **Contact**: info@hydoilpress.com, +86-18957149128 (WhatsApp/WeChat)
- **Languages supported**: English, French, Arabic, Indonesian
- **Warranty**: 1-year full machine, 3-month wearing parts, 48-hour technical response
- **Certifications**: CE, ISO 9001

## Core Products (Hydraulic Oil Press Machines)

### HN325 Standard Hydraulic Oil Press
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/standard-hydraulic-oil-press/
Slug: standard-hydraulic-oil-press | Model: HN325 | Force: 325 tons | Pressure: 27-30 MPa

Summary: Entry-level double-barrel hydraulic press for small businesses and village-level oil mills.
Single-phase power available. Best for low-to-medium daily volume.

- **Capacity**: 200-500 kg/day (8-hour shift, single barrel)
- **Cycle time**: 25-35 min per batch
- **Oil yield**: peanut 40-50%, sesame 42-54%, sunflower 38-48%, mustard 35-45%
- **Power**: 380V/50Hz 3-phase 7.5 kW (220V 1-phase available as custom)
- **Dimensions**: 1750 x 1050 x 1700 mm | Weight: ~1,200 kg
- **Materials**: 27SiMn steel cylinder, 304 stainless steel barrel
- **Process**: Hot press (standard), cold press (optional cooler)
- **Target users**: Small business owners, local oil mills, home-based production
- **Recommended for**: Sesame, peanut, sunflower, mustard, canola
- **FOB Price range**: Contact for quotation (single/double barrel options)

FAQ:
- Q: Can it run on 220V? A: Standard is 380V 3-phase. 220V 1-phase available as custom order (+$300).
- Q: How many kg per hour? A: 25-40 kg/hour depending on seed type and moisture content.
- Q: Is it suitable for cold-press (VCO)? A: Yes, add optional cooling system.

### HN365 Commercial Hydraulic Oil Press
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/commercial-hydraulic-oil-press/
Slug: commercial-hydraulic-oil-press | Model: HN365 | Force: 365 tons | Pressure: 27-30 MPa

Summary: Mid-range commercial press with double-barrel standard. Higher throughput with less waiting
between batches. Most popular model in Nigeria, Kenya, and India.

- **Capacity**: 500-1,200 kg/day (8-hour shift, double barrel)
- **Cycle time**: 30-40 min per batch
- **Oil yield**: peanut 40-50%, sesame 42-54%, sunflower 38-48%, cottonseed 28-38%
- **Power**: 380V/50Hz 3-phase 11 kW (415V/60Hz for Nigeria custom)
- **Dimensions**: 1950 x 1150 x 1750 mm | Weight: ~1,500 kg
- **Materials**: 27SiMn steel cylinder, 304 stainless steel barrel
- **Process**: Hot press (standard), cold press capable (temperature-controlled)
- **Target users**: Mid-size commercial oil mills, cooperative processing centers
- **Recommended for**: Peanut, sesame, sunflower, mustard, rapeseed, olive
- **FOB Price range**: Contact for quotation

### HN426 Cold-Press Hydraulic Oil Press
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/cold-press-hydraulic-oil-press/
Slug: cold-press-hydraulic-oil-press | Model: HN426 | Force: 500 tons | Pressure: 36-42 MPa

Summary: Cold-press optimized for premium and hard-to-press seeds. 42 MPa pressure releases
maximum oil from dense kernels (palm kernel, shea nut, walnut). Maintains low temperature
(≤60°C) to preserve nutritional value and flavor.

- **Capacity**: 400-800 kg/day (8-hour shift)
- **Cycle time**: 40-60 min per batch (harder seeds take longer)
- **Oil yield**: coconut 55-65% (VCO quality), walnut 55-65%, palm kernel 45-52%, shea butter 40-50%
- **Power**: 380V/50Hz 3-phase 15 kW
- **Dimensions**: 2050 x 1200 x 1850 mm | Weight: ~1,800 kg
- **Pressure**: Up to 42 MPa (vs 27-30 MPa on standard models)
- **Key feature**: Enhanced pressure frame for hard seeds, temperature-controlled cooling system
- **Target users**: Premium oil producers, cosmetic-grade shea butter/VCO, health food brands
- **Recommended for**: Coconut (VCO), palm kernel, shea butter, walnut, almond, avocado
- **FOB Price range**: Contact for quotation

### HN500 Ultra High Pressure Hydraulic Oil Press
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/ultra-high-pressure-hydraulic-oil-press/
Slug: ultra-high-pressure-hydraulic-oil-press | Model: HN500 | Force: 620 tons | Pressure: 48-52 MPa

Summary: Industrial flagship model for continuous multi-ton production. Highest pressure
in Haonuo lineup. Suitable for buyers scaling beyond single-barrel operation.

- **Capacity**: 1,500-3,000 kg/day (with 2-3 barrel configuration)
- **Cycle time**: 35-50 min per batch
- **Oil yield**: highest across all models (adds 2-5% yield vs HN365 on hard seeds)
- **Power**: 380V/50Hz 3-phase 22 kW
- **Dimensions**: 2250 x 1300 x 1950 mm | Weight: ~2,500 kg
- **Materials**: Reinforced 27SiMn steel, thicker barrel walls
- **Target users**: Large commercial mills, factory-level production, multi-seed processing
- **FOB Price range**: Contact for quotation

### Seed Processing Equipment
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/seed-processing-equipment/
Seed crushers (high-speed 7.5 kW, industrial 15 kW), integrated feeder-crusher-roasters,
oilseed pre-press. Complementary equipment for complete production lines.

### Roasting & Steaming Equipment
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/roasting-steaming-equipment/
Automatic drum roasters (electric + wood-fired), thermal oil roasting pans. Pre-heating
seeds boosts yield by 2-4% on most oil types.

### Filtration & Refining Equipment
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/products/filtration-refining-equipment/
Pneumatic oil filter presses, crude oil refining systems. Post-extraction clarification
for food-grade and cosmetic-grade oil quality.

## Buyer Guides & Resources

### Hydraulic Oil Press Buying Guide
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/resources/hydraulic-oil-press-buying-guide/
Covers: How to choose tonnage (325/365/426/500), pressure requirements, barrel count
(single vs double), heat exchanger options, 220V vs 380V electrical, factory verification
checklist before paying deposit. Key question: "How many kg per day do you need?"

### Oil Press Machine Price Guide
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/resources/oil-press-machine-price-guide/
Price range by model and configuration. Factors affecting price: tonnage, barrel type,
voltage customization, included accessories (roaster, filter, conveyor), FOB vs CIF.
No exact prices listed — contact for quotation.

### How to Maximize Oil Yield
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/resources/how-to-maximize-oil-yield/
Top yield factors: seed moisture content (8-12% optimal), particle size (3-5 mm),
pre-heat temperature, pressure applied, holding time, cake thickness control.

### Cold Press vs Hot Press Oil
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/resources/cold-press-vs-hot-press-oil/
Cold press: higher quality, more nutrients preserved, lower yield (5-10% less).
Hot press: higher yield, darker color, suitable for bulk food-grade oil.
When to choose cold press: VCO, mustard Kachi Ghani, cosmetic shea butter, avocado.

### Complete Oil Production Line Guide
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/resources/complete-oil-production-line-guide/
From seed to bottled oil: cleaning → crushing → cooking → pressing → filtration →
settling → bottling. Haonuo supplies presses, roasters, crushers, filters, conveyors,
and refining systems for complete turnkey lines.

### SOP: Palm Kernel Oil Pressing
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/resources/palm-kernel-oil-pressing-sop/
4-step field-tested process: (1) shell cracking → (2) kernel crushing → (3) high-pressure
hydraulic pressing at 42 MPa, 40-50 min/batch → (4) filtration & 72-hour settling.
45-52% yield, 6-8% residual oil in cake. Recommended models: HN426, HN500.

### SOP: Mustard Oil Pressing (Cold + Hot)
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/resources/mustard-oil-pressing-sop/
Cold-press Kachi Ghani: 5-step process targeting ≤60°C temperature.
Hot-press: 5-step process with 10-15 min steam pre-heat at 90°C for 2-4% higher yield.
Recommended models: HN325-HN365.

### SOP: Coconut Oil Pressing (VCO)
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/resources/coconut-oil-pressing-sop/
Virgin Coconut Oil cold-press SOP using fresh coconut or copra.
4 steps: prepare feedstock → load → cold press at 27-30 MPa, ≤60°C → filter & bottle.
Recommended model: HN426.

### SOP: Shea Butter Pressing
URL: https://www.hydoilpress.com/resources/shea-butter-pressing-sop/
Cosmetic-grade (HN426) vs food-grade (HN365) configurations.
4 steps: crack & clean → grind → hydraulic press → filter & cool.
